grounding_policy: Use retrieved guidance as a checklist; facts must come from user documents or cited public sources.
privacy: index checked-in guidance and approved local input files in an isolated per-run namespace; do not send private files to public research.
purpose: Retrieve procurement guidance and approved local evidence for supplier quotes, technical fit, total cost, policy, risk, and comparison checks.
retrieval_targets: supplier quote, configuration, availability, and delivery facts
total cost of ownership and recurring support or energy costs
warranty, return, support, security, and supplier-risk gaps
